claim: Design the complete independent Refine repository architecture: allocate all fixed contracts across coherent generated theories, plan shared results and justified theory collaboration, and explain scheduling and design tradeoffs; local proof DAGs belong to File Planner.

model.role: Design contract-to-theory allocation, semantic boundaries, shared-result strategy, justified theory predecessors and ready-theory priority across the entire repository.

allowed_planner_inputs: compact cards for every verified Refine contract
exact contract records returned by bounded inspect_contracts requests
Native-verified static frozen-parent and retained-semantic premise records returned by explicit searches and inspection
Owner-independent contract semantic summaries, legal context profiles and shared-symbol relation candidates
forbidden_planner_inputs: raw human Refine proof bodies or unrestricted repository reads
deleted human helper names, statements, proof order or proof graph
CRefine data or results from another experiment
environment IDs, private preparation inventories, recovery journals and checkpoints
Original contract theory owners, owner-bearing IDs, source file slots, owner groups, original theory import graph, or same-owner relation features

rules.fixed_contracts: Every fixed contract occurs exactly once. Copy frozen statements/context/attributes; never accept model replacements.
rules.theory_grouping: Group from shared semantic operations, state access/update behavior and invariants, inspecting frozen declarations and contexts. Separate physical theory ownership from advisory collaboration groups. Choose manageable coherent theories; do not copy original ownership, prescribe exact helpers/proof routes, or split merely to meet a quota.
rules.premises: Retrieve established lemmas by name, definition or concept; inspect full statements before reuse. No proof-state query at repository planning time. Pending contracts and new helpers are never premises.
rules.failure: File Planner may revise exploratory candidates and non-contract helpers using Isabelle feedback. Fixed contracts cannot be deleted or weakened; accepted proof dependencies must remain valid. Preserve attempt history and distinguish failed proofs from infrastructure errors.
rules.validation: Agent incrementally edits plan.json and calls trusted validate/preflight/submit tools. Exact coverage, legal inspected facts, acyclic providers and native declaration/import preflight are required before publication.
rules.context_budget: Whole public contract catalog and exact records are read-only files. Definitions and premises are explicit queries. Related-symbol candidates are on demand. No query-turn or proposal-correction cap.
rules.auxiliary_intents: Optional shared-result intentions; precise statements and local dependencies belong to File Planner.
rules.theory_dependencies: Only required_imports create mandatory provider imports and readiness dependencies. Providers must seal before consumer startup and imports then freeze. collaboration_groups and reuse_suggestions are advisory and grant no premise visibility; reciprocal reuse suggestions do not enter the hard DAG.
rules.priority: Theory array order is the explicit tie-break among ready theories; predecessor edges take precedence.
rules.iteration: Agent edits its durable plan and notes, chooses inspection, retrieval, validation, native preflight and explicit submission. No query or correction limit. Transport timeouts are separate from validation failures.
rules.architecture_review: Review shared-operation families and restricted/general cases before broad protocol groupings. Distinguish semantic/context requirements from possible proof reuse; only the former justify mandatory imports. Leave uncertain assistance advisory, and resolve real import cycles by regrouping or a common lower layer. Local helpers and proof routes evolve in File Planner.
